address: 6/11 Phang-Nga 3025 Rural Road, Thai Mueang, Phang-Nga, 82120, Thailand
bio: Aunty Oui has been delighting locals with the intense flavour of her noodle soups since 1971. Each table is laden with a basket of soft-boiled eggs; diners are welcome to finish as many as they can manage. The pork rib soup is a highlight and a Thai dessert rounds off the meal nicely....
